# What this build can actually withhold: one "<object> <field>" per line, sorted.
#
# Rendered from the enforcing code by the render test in the module that owns
# each object — deals/maskablefields_test.go for the deal, and
# contacts/partnermaskablefields_test.go for the partner — and compared against
# a migrated database's maskable_field table by
# compose/integration/maskablefieldparity_integration_test.go. Neither side may
# move without the other: a pair the code withholds and the table does not offer
# cannot be configured at all, and a pair the table offers and no code withholds
# is a mask an administrator sets and nothing applies.
#
# An object listed here that nothing masks is caught by
# gates/maskablefieldobjects_test.go, which no single module's render test can
# see: a module may not import its sibling, so each renders its own object only.
deal amount_minor
deal company_id
deal currency
deal expected_arr_minor
deal partner_company_id
deal project_id
partner margin_tier
